newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne shareholders still reject hostile offer.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne shareholders still reject hostile offer.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc said Tuesday it was pleased only 18 percent of the company's total outstanding shares were tendered into the unsolicited hostile tender offer of Invacare Corp.
Ivacare's offer has been open for about two months and earlier today, it said it would extend its $13 per share tender offer fo Helathdyne until April 7.
Helathdyne said the low number of shares tendered again indicated support for its postion the Invacare offer is "grossly" inadequate.

Helathdyne also stated it was gratified the Georgia Senate yesterday voted not to reconsider its passage of a bill that would automatically provide for staggered terms for the board of directors of Georgia public companies who do not opt out of its provisions.
Invacare said it wil nominate a slate of directors to run against Healthdyne's.
Healthdyne Technologies makes and sells medical devices for use in the home and specialized clinical settings.
